Description: After being torn apart by something bizarre, He Yizhen jolts awake in her seat. Was it all just a dream? Why does she remember it so clearly? And most importantly¡ªwill it all happen again?

A suspicious group called the Troupe Elysium, cloaked in hooded robes and hiding their faces behind masks, has been active throughout Yuntai City lately. They seem to be preparing for a performance at the upcoming city festival and are actively promoting it. No official force has intervened to stop them.

Held once every two years, the Qiqiao Festival is a major event deeply valued by the people of Yuntai. It was once a traditional celebration to honor the Double Stars and pray for blessings, but has since evolved into a more competitive modern spectacle. Many of its original customs have faded from public knowledge.

During the three-day Qiqiao Festival, Yuntai City enforces a lockdown, temporarily restricting travel in and out of the city. In recent years, the city¡¯s situation has been increasingly unstable¡ªdespite the lockdown, disturbances have occasionally broken out during the festival.

The flight attendant blocking the entrance to first class claims the purser suddenly instructed her to stand guard at her current post and not leave until further notice. A long time has passed since the order, and no follow-up has been received.
